subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: While the switch-over is in effect, the system shall describe the feature draft as the way new features are contracted in the repository's agent instructions, pipeline map, and domain model.
rationale: Agents learn the process from these surfaces (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-11)
fit_criterion: The agent instructions, pipeline map, and domain model name the feature draft for new features and reserve the per-stage document rules for existing documents; the operator confirms in review.
